title: Module 14 Interpretation Check
intro: Each item gives you a short research situation. Decide what the evidence supports.

items.q: For a set of data, SP = 24 and SS of X = 16. What is the slope?
With M of X = 10, M of Y = 40, and b = 1.5, what is the intercept?
Using Y-hat = 1.5X + 25, what is the predicted Y when X = 12?
A multiple regression with 2 predictors and n = 40 has R squared = .30. The test gives F(2, 37) = 7.93, p = .001. What is the correct conclusion?
o: The predictors together account for a significant portion of the variability in the outcome
items.why: The omnibus F tests whether R squared differs from zero. Individual coefficients need their own tests.

items.q: A student says, "Since the slope is 1.5 and my friend's is .3 on a different outcome, the first relationship is five times stronger." What is wrong?
o: Slopes depend on the units of measurement, so they cannot be compared across different variables
items.why: Standardize the variables or compare r and r squared.
